+"""Generate one deterministic pick-and-place trajectory for the frozen RoboLab scene."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    s = Session("non_hammer_tools_in_right_bin", instance=INSTANCE)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    q_down_y = p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([0, 1]))
+    q_down_x = p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1, 0]))
+    s.record_start()
+
+    def transport(name: str, grasp_xy: tuple[float, float], close_xy,
+                  destination_xy: tuple[float, float], quat) -> None:
+        gx, gy = grasp_xy
+        p["open_gripper"](steps=5)
+        p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.22], quat, speed=0.16)
+        p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.018], quat, speed=0.09)
+        p["close_gripper"](steps=20)
+        p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.22], quat, speed=0.12)
+
+        ee_pos, _ = s.ee_pose()
+        object_pos, _ = p["get_object_pose"](name)
+        lift = float(object_pos[2] - (0.03 if name == "cordless_drill" else 0.02))
+        print(f"{name} after grasp/lift: object={np.round(object_pos, 4).tolist()} "
+              f"ee={np.round(ee_pos, 4).tolist()} lift={lift:.3f}", flush=True)
+
+        # Preserve the measured object-to-EEF offset so its centroid lands at the
+        # intended location even when the pinch is away from the object's centroid.
+        offset = ee_pos - object_pos
+        target_ee_xy = np.asarray(destination_xy, dtype=float) + offset[:2]
+        p["move_ee"]([target_ee_xy[0], target_ee_xy[1], 0.22], quat, speed=0.16)
+        # Lower the held tool inside the bin, then let it settle onto the bottom.
+        p["move_ee"]([target_ee_xy[0], target_ee_xy[1], 0.075], quat, speed=0.10)
+        p["open_gripper"](steps=8)
+        p["hold"](steps=60)
+        print(f"{name} after release: {p['get_object_pose'](name)[0].round(4).tolist()} "
+              f"status={s.status()}", flush=True)
+
+    # The drill lies on its side. Pinch the narrower grip with the fingers closing
+    # along x. The clamp is pinched across its central body along y.
+    transport("cordless_drill", (0.385, 0.040), [1, 0], (0.515, -0.313), q_down_x)
+    if not s.episode_done:
+        transport("spring_clamp", (0.612, -0.104), [0, 1], (0.690, -0.313), q_down_y)
+

+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+        "generator": "gen.py",
+        "n_actions": int(len(actions)),

"""Generate one deterministic pick-and-place trajectory for the frozen RoboLab scene."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session


OUT = Path("/app/output")
INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"


def main() -> None:
    stale = OUT / "trajectory.npz"
    if stale.exists():
        stale.unlink()
    s = Session("non_hammer_tools_in_right_bin", instance=INSTANCE)
    try:
        p = s.primitives()
        dir_x = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1, 0])
        dir_y = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([0, 1])
        dir_diag_a = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1, 1])
        dir_diag_b = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1, -1])
        dir_x_reverse = dir_x + np.pi

        def find_grasp(name: str, candidates: list[tuple[float, float, float, float]]):
            initial_z = float(s.objects()[name]["position"][2])
            for gx, gy, yaw, low_z in candidates:
                s.reset()
                quat = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)
                try:
                    p["open_gripper"](steps=3)
                    p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.22], quat, speed=0.16)
                    p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, low_z], quat, speed=0.08)
                    p["close_gripper"](steps=24)
                    in_contact = bool(s.world.in_contact(name, "gripper", env_id=0))
                    if not in_contact:
                        print(f"{name} candidate {(gx, gy, yaw, low_z)} no gripper contact", flush=True)
                        continue
                    if abs(gx - 0.37) < 1e-6 and gy > 0.05:
                        from PIL import Image
                        Image.fromarray(s.render_frame("egocentric_mirrored_camera")).save(OUT / "grasp_debug.png")
                        Image.fromarray(s.render_frame("wrist_cam")).save(OUT / "grasp_debug_wrist.png")
                    p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.22], quat, speed=0.12)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(f"{name} candidate {(gx, gy, yaw, low_z)} failed: {exc}", flush=True)
                    continue
                pos = np.asarray(s.objects()[name]["position"], dtype=float)
                dz = float(pos[2] - initial_z)
                print(f"{name} candidate {(gx, gy, yaw, low_z)} lifted by {dz:.3f} m", flush=True)
                if dz > 0.045:
                    s.reset()
                    return gx, gy, yaw, low_z
            raise RuntimeError(f"No successful {name} grasp found")

        # Start with graspable cross-sections on the drill's handle and housing.
        # The gripper closes across x here, then across y for the alternate points.
        drill_candidates = [
            (0.360, 0.040, dir_x, 0.020),
            (0.370, 0.040, dir_x, 0.020),
            (0.380, 0.040, dir_x, 0.020),
            (0.360, 0.055, dir_x, 0.020),
            (0.370, 0.055, dir_x, 0.020),
            (0.380, 0.055, dir_x, 0.020),
            (0.370, 0.060, dir_x, 0.035),
            (0.380, 0.060, dir_x, 0.035),
            (0.340, 0.040, dir_x, 0.035),
            (0.350, 0.055, dir_x, 0.035),
            (0.370, 0.055, dir_x_reverse, 0.020),
            (0.370, 0.055, dir_diag_a, 0.025),
            (0.370, 0.055, dir_diag_b, 0.025),
            (0.360, 0.055, dir_y, 0.025),
        ]
        clamp_candidates = [
            (0.612, -0.104, dir_y, 0.015),
            (0.612, -0.104, dir_x, 0.015),
            (0.640, -0.104, dir_y, 0.015),
            (0.580, -0.104, dir_y, 0.015),
            (0.612, -0.135, dir_y, 0.015),
            (0.612, -0.075, dir_y, 0.015),
            (0.640, -0.075, dir_x, 0.015),
            (0.580, -0.135, dir_x, 0.015),
            (0.612, -0.104, dir_diag_a, 0.015),
            (0.612, -0.104, dir_diag_b, 0.015),
        ]
        drill_grasp = find_grasp("cordless_drill", drill_candidates)
        clamp_grasp = find_grasp("spring_clamp", clamp_candidates)

        s.reset()
        s.record_start()

        def transport(name: str, grasp, destination_xy: tuple[float, float]) -> None:
            gx, gy, yaw, low_z = grasp
            quat = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)
            p["open_gripper"](steps=5)
            p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.22], quat, speed=0.16)
            p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, low_z], quat, speed=0.08)
            p["close_gripper"](steps=24)
            p["move_ee"]([gx, gy, 0.22], quat, speed=0.12)
            ee_pos, _ = s.ee_pose()
            object_pos, _ = p["get_object_pose"](name)
            print(f"{name} in recorded pickup: {np.round(object_pos, 4).tolist()}", flush=True)
            offset = ee_pos - object_pos
            target_ee_xy = np.asarray(destination_xy, dtype=float) + offset[:2]
            p["move_ee"]([target_ee_xy[0], target_ee_xy[1], 0.22], quat, speed=0.16)
            p["move_ee"]([target_ee_xy[0], target_ee_xy[1], 0.075], quat, speed=0.10)
            p["open_gripper"](steps=8)
            p["hold"](steps=60)
            print(f"{name} release: {p['get_object_pose'](name)[0].round(4).tolist()} "
                  f"status={s.status()}", flush=True)

        transport("cordless_drill", drill_grasp, (0.515, -0.313))
        if not s.episode_done:
            transport("spring_clamp", clamp_grasp, (0.690, -0.313))

        actions = s.record_stop()
        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={
            "description": "Pick the drill and spring clamp and drop both into the right bin.",
            "generator": "gen.py",
            "n_actions": int(len(actions)),
            "status": s.status(),
        })
        print("saved", OUT / "trajectory.npz", "actions", len(actions), "status", json.dumps(s.status()), flush=True)
    finally:
        s.app.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
